title_original: 항만지역등 대기질 개선에 관한 특별법 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 7 (Criteria for Environmentally Friendly Loading and Unloading Equipment, etc.)
① Under Article 15 of the Act, "the standards specified in Article 15(1)(1) of the Act" refers to the emission standards for gases specified in Annex.
② Under Article 15 of the Act, "environmentally friendly energy specified in the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries Act" refers to any of the following:
1. Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG)
2. Compressed Natural Gas (CNG)
3. Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG)
4. Methanol
5. Hydrogen
6. Electricity
7. Any other energy that the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries deems necessary for the creation of a clean port atmosphere.
